De Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) subsidie: The Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) subsidy is available to parties active in the plastics and recycling chain. The total available budget is €40 million. Up to €1.5 million can be awarded per research project and up to €7.5 million per showcase project. Applications must be submitted by a consortium. The subsidy closes on 6 October 2026 at 17:00.
